## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run gate:pr` passes locally, or the PR explains why it could not run.
- [ ] Public docs are updated for API, CLI, MCP, HTTP, benchmark, or safety-boundary changes.
- [ ] Benchmark-touching changes avoid official/SOTA claim language unless an official-protocol reproduction bundle is attached.
- [ ] No real user memory, private transcripts, API keys, or production SQLite files are included.
- [ ] No push-triggered CI workflow was added.
